subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the work to another refreshed candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping candidate PRs, while this branch still has contributor-proof and code-review blockers that automation cannot safely settle as a product/canonical-branch choice.

options.title: Repair This Branch First
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, and inspectable app-auth proof before final merge review.

options.title: Use The Member Candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes the clean, proof-accepted, mergeable canonical implementation.

options.title: Waive Live Proof Explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept source/API-contract proof, but the predicate and metadata blockers still need repair before merge.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch First
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, and inspectable app-auth proof before final merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API, media, action, and outbound plumbing history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the canonical-fix choice.
